reason: qwen3.8-max hit the v3 preregistered 3/3 ceiling on 530b157 before donor acquisition.
order_basis: Pre-existing local router catalog order after excluding qwen3.8-max; fixed before any alternative-candidate benchmark outcome is observed.

shared_runtime.base_prompt: unchanged official AppWorld simplified ReAct prompt
shared_runtime.transport: Mac AppWorld -> project SSE-to-JSON adapter -> existing local router

candidate_gate.floor_rule: 0/3 official success AND mean official passed-test fraction <= 0.30 AND no task issues complete_task => FLOOR_REJECT
candidate_gate.usable_rule: Any other complete benchmark outcome => USABLE_SELECT
candidate_gate.infrastructure_failure: Transport/API/harness failure before a valid task outcome is not a scientific score; record it, keep parameters fixed, and continue to the next candidate only if the failure cannot be repaired without changing benchmark/policy semantics.

selection_rule.policy: Select the first candidate in candidate_order with USABLE_SELECT.

provenance_rules: Each candidate starts with no private experience and fresh independent AppWorld worlds.
No donor acquisition is run until a candidate is selected.
No target outcome changes candidate order, task set, max steps, prompt, memory policy, or ceiling/floor rules.

Each candidate run is synchronized to Shervin with compact result, run log, environment_io, lm_calls, api_calls, evaluator report, usage, and version metadata before the next scientific decision is recorded.
terminal_rule: If all three candidates are rejected as ceiling/floor or invalid after semantic-preserving transport repair, stop A-T03 and version a new development design rather than selecting by favorable outcome.
